top_signals.title: Petrobras' Deepwater Push Sets Off a Race for Offshore Vessels
top_signals.summary: Recently, we reported that the Middle East conflict and subsequent closure of the Strait of Hormuz has triggered an unprecedented spike in freight and shipping rates, with Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC) spot rates now exceeding $1 million per day. The sharp spike is now reshaping oil flows and forcing producers to cut prices in a bid to help buyers offset extra transport costs. The situation is a little different in Brazil, where the offshore sector is facing a potential vessel shortage as demand outruns supply amid the offshore oil boom, positioning…

top_signals.title: Starbucks China Will Require Purchases to Sit in Its Cafes
top_signals.summary: Starbucks Corp. will require customers to make a purchase to sit in its China cafes, part of a push to revive its fortunes in the competitive mainland market.

top_signals.title: Rubio to Discuss Venezuelan Crude with Ambani
top_signals.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio hopes to discuss Venezuelan crude in his meeting with Reliance Industries' Chairman Mukesh Ambani at Jamnagar in India's western state of Gujarat. "This is a company that has the capability to refine the heavy crude that's produced in the western hemisphere, including from Venezuela," he told reporters on Wednesday. (Source: Bloomberg)
